It is a name that represents the first female in a group or organization. In Islamic tradition, Raidah is also the name of one of the Prophet Muhammad's female servants. The name has gained popularity over the years in different Muslim cultures and is now widely used in many countries. In modern times, Raidah represents a woman who is innovative, responsible, and courageous, with a forward-thinking approach to life.
